notes: As built: Fury is stored in the Rage slot, one Rage unit a point (class powers P2, brief class-powers-2026-10-17: the x10 convention retires; before it ten Rage units a point, docs/design/01-stats). Its out-of-combat loss is the core's own Rage decay rule at the core's rate in points, 1 Fury a second (Player::Regenerate, 20 units per 2 s at ten a point, at Rate.Rage.Loss), paid by the module's resource pulse a step every combat.resource_pulse_ms with the core tick masked (diablocraft-dupme); the pulse takes the stock loss per point, so the rate is the same at one unit a point. Colour is stock PowerBarColor RAGE (FrameXML UnitFrame.lua:3). starts_full 0 (ruling 2026-10-14, card q-1014-21): Fury stays empty on entering the world, as D3 has it (the core sets Rage to 0 when it resets a player's powers, Player::ResetAllPowers, Player.cpp:2087).

Q1=1A (decisions.md 2026-09-23 Class resource model): Arcane Power is stored in the Energy slot, one Energy per point (diablocraft-resource-rollout-a item 4; before it, the Mana slot 1:1 under decisions.md 2026-09-22 Wizard part A Q4). D3 regenerates it at 10/s, Energy's own native rate, and the cap of 100 is Arcane Power's (Player::Regenerate, pinned core Player.cpp:1939-1948); Energy has no stock decay. paid_by module (class powers P2, the designer's ride-along 'right now wizard still gains power in chunks'): the resource pulse (dc_resource_pulse.cpp) pays its 10/s every combat.resource_pulse_ms with the core's Energy tick masked (generate_spells.py REGENERATION_MASK) and writes the rate into the slot's regeneration fields, as the Crusader's Wrath; the core sent Energy only every 2 s (Player.cpp:2017-2020). A regeneration percent aura on the slot (the Empowered Shrine's) still multiplies it, as the core's own Energy rule does. Colour is stock PowerBarColor ENERGY (FrameXML UnitFrame.lua:6). starts_full 1: the core fills Energy when it resets a player's powers (Player::ResetAllPowers, Player.cpp:2090), and dc_stats.cpp Login sets a resource that starts full to its maximum.

Q1=1A (decisions.md 2026-09-23 Class resource model): Wrath on Energy, one Energy per point. D3 regenerates it at 2.5/s in and out of combat. paid_by module: the resource pulse (dc_resource_pulse.cpp) pays it every combat.resource_pulse_ms with the core's Energy tick masked (generate_spells.py REGENERATION_MASK), and writes the rate into the slot's regeneration fields; the energy_rate record (diablocraft-55e0k) stays, so the core's own field write (Player::UpdateEnergyRegen) gives the same -7.5. starts_full 0 (D3; PM 2026-10-16 on diablocraft-txze9): Wrath starts empty on entering the world, 'The Wrath resource globe starts out empty, like the Barbarian's Fury' (crusader_resource.csv row Starting Wrath); the core fills Energy when it resets a player's powers (Player::ResetAllPowers, Player.cpp:2090), so dc_stats.cpp Login sets a resource that does not start full to 0. Colour #E8ECD9: D3's own, pale gold-white (ruling 2026-10-16, card q-1016-29, 'Take D3's defaults'), measured from D3's own resource globe art (reference/D3 Assets/Base/Textures/2DUI_CrusaderResourceGlobe.tex/.png, frame 0: the mean of the brightest tenth of its lit pixels).

Q1=1A: Hatred on Energy (the main bar), one Energy per point. D3 regenerates it at 5/s in and out of combat (d3/class_resources.csv; the client's 4.0 against the planner's 5 is G2's, 5 stands by the D3-default rule). paid_by module (class powers P2): the resource pulse (dc_resource_pulse.cpp) pays it every combat.resource_pulse_ms with the core's Energy tick masked (generate_spells.py REGENERATION_MASK, once the class is live) and writes the rate into the slot's regeneration fields, as the Crusader's Wrath. starts_full 1: the Demon Hunter build brief's done line (demon-hunter-build-2026-10-17, the designer approved 2026-10-16): logs in at 70 and sees Hatred 125 of 125 (both full out of combat, as D3); the local start value is not found (docs/research/demon-hunter/demon_hunter_resource.csv Starting Hatred and Discipline, G2 question 2), revisited when G2 answers. Colour #853215: D3's own, red-orange (ruling 2026-10-16, card q-1016-29, 'Take D3's defaults'), measured from D3's own resource globe art (reference/D3 Assets/Base/Textures/2DUI_DemonHunterResourceGlobe.tex/.png, frame 0: the mean of the brightest tenth of its lit pixels, the globe's left half).

Discipline in the Focus slot, one Focus per point, the Demon Hunter's second real power (decisions.md 2026-10-16 The Demon Hunter, the build: 'Discipline 30 at 1/s as a real second power in the Focus slot'; it supersedes the 2026-09-23 Mana choice). No player class uses Focus in 3.3.5 (pets only: Unit::GetCreatePowers, Unit.cpp:12131), the core never regenerates it for a player (Player::Regenerate, Player.cpp:1961), and the stock Mana second bar stays out of it. paid_by module: the resource pulse pays its 1/s with the core's tick masked and writes the rate into the slot's regeneration fields; its maximum is its pool (dc_stats.cpp, the max-power hook; Paragon gives Discipline none, paragon.csv). starts_full 1: the build brief's done line, a Discipline bar at 30 of 30 (both full out of combat, as D3); the local start value is not found (G2 question 2). Colour #6161A4: D3's own, cool blue-white (ruling 2026-10-16, card q-1016-29, 'Take D3's defaults'), measured from D3's own resource globe art (reference/D3 Assets/Base/Textures/2DUI_DemonHunterResourceGlobe.tex/.png, frame 0: the mean of the brightest tenth of its lit pixels, the globe's right half).

Q1=1A: Spirit on Runic Power, one unit a point (class powers P2, brief class-powers-2026-10-17: the x10 convention retires; before it ten units a point), decay off: a class 12 body is not a Death Knight, so the core neither regenerates nor decays its Runic Power (Player::RegenerateAll, Player.cpp:1844-1847). Colour is stock PowerBarColor RUNIC_POWER 0.00/0.82/1.00 (FrameXML UnitFrame.lua:9). starts_full 1 (ruling 2026-10-14, card q-1014-21): a Monk enters the world with Spirit at its maximum, as the Wizard's Arcane Power does (the core zeroes Runic Power when it resets a player's powers, Player::ResetAllPowers, Player.cpp:2093, and at creation, Player.cpp:618, so the stats login sets it full: dc_stats.cpp Login); no regeneration stays as built, Spirit still only comes from the skills.

Colour #2EA78F: D3's own, teal (ruling 2026-10-16, card q-1016-29, 'Take D3's defaults'), measured from D3's own resource globe art (reference/D3 Assets/Base/Textures/2DUI_NecromancerResourceGlobe.tex/.png, frame 0: the mean of the brightest tenth of its lit pixels).

Q1=1A: Witch Doctor Mana on Mana, one per point, 750 at every level. D3 regenerates it at 50/s in and out of combat (witch_doctor_resource.csv). paid_by module: the resource pulse pays the 50/s a fine step at a time with the core's own Mana tick masked, as the Wizard's, Crusader's and Demon Hunter's Energy is. Starts full: the brief's done line is Mana 750 of 750 (D3 gives no starting value, G2 question 2; D3 default in the meantime, login full, no decay). Colour is stock PowerBarColor MANA (FrameXML UnitFrame.lua:2).

Maelstrom on the Fury model's own slot, Rage, one Rage unit a point (the brief's Step 1: 'Maelstrom on a Fury-model row ... the Barbarian's Rage slot first'). Rage is the slot the model already runs on: a module-paid row (the resource pulse, the core's tick masked), starts 0 (the core sets Rage to 0 when it resets a player's powers, Player::ResetAllPowers, Player.cpp:2087, so starts_full 0 needs nothing at login), and the draft's timed loss: decay timed, 5 Maelstrom a second once 5 seconds have passed out of combat (draft v1.4 section 1.4), the rate and the wait two combat.csv rows (maelstrom_decay_per_second, maelstrom_decay_wait_seconds) the resource pulse reads live (Shaman 2b). Rage rewards: the stock RewardRage hook (core patch 0002) is refused for every class whose primary resource is on the Rage slot, this row's class too (dc_stats.cpp CanRewardRage reads the registry). Colour #558FF2 is the mean of the brightest tenth of the lit pixels of the Maelstrom orb (a blue centre fading to a subtle purple edge, ruling q-1021-157; client-patch/art/ui/elvui/maelstrom_orb_fill.py), measured as the other powers' colours are.
